quests.ashwood.steps[0]: Follow the east road to the unlit lamp tower in the Ashwood
quests.ashwood.steps[1]: Offer sparks at the Ashwood tower to light it
quests.ashwood.steps[2]: Hunt boars in the north of the Ashwood
quests.ashwood.steps[3]: Drive off the goblin pack in the south of the Ashwood
quests.ashwood.steps[4]: Defeat the Ash Troll at the far east of the woods. Bring others if you can
quests.ashwood.title: Chapter 3 · A Lamp for the Ashwood
quests.bram.steps[0]: Hunt slimes in the western field to gather sparks
quests.bram.steps[1]: Offer a spark at the lamp tower in the village
quests.bram.steps[2]: Find the old forge beyond the western woods
quests.bram.steps[3]: Defeat Bram's Shade, lost to the mist
quests.bram.steps[4]: Use "Give" in the lamp tower panel to bring villagers back (the panel shows who is next)
quests.bram.title: Chapter 1 · The Sound of a Hammer
quests.ember.steps[0]: From the Ashwood Tower, follow the main road east to the unlit tower of Emberfall Heights (level 15+ recommended)
quests.ember.steps[1]: Hunt cinder foxes in the northwest of the heights
quests.ember.steps[2]: Offer sparks at the Emberfall Tower to light it. Time to spend the sparks you have saved
quests.ember.steps[3]: Drive off the highland raiders in the southwest of the heights
quests.ember.steps[4]: Offer more sparks at the Emberfall Tower to brighten the heights
quests.ember.steps[5]: Defeat the ember wardens in the southeast of the heights
quests.ember.steps[6]: Defeat the Ember Colossus at the north end of the heights. Better to go with others
quests.ember.title: Chapter 5 · The Emberfall Tower
quests.halmeom.steps[0]: Offer sparks at the Firstlight Village tower. Granny has kept this flame all her life
quests.halmeom.steps[1]: Defeat lost soldiers in the east of the Ashwood. They were keepers once, before the mist took them
quests.halmeom.steps[2]: Help hold off a mist raid at the village tower. Raids come on the hour at noon, 3, 6 and 8 to 11 pm
quests.halmeom.title: Chapter 4 · The Keeper's Night
quests.mira.steps[0]: Buy a potion from the road merchant in the village
quests.mira.steps[1]: Hunt wisps in the southern woods
quests.mira.steps[2]: Find the old herb field east of the pond
quests.mira.steps[3]: Defeat Mira's Shade, lost to the mist
quests.mira.steps[4]: Use "Give" in the lamp tower panel to bring more villagers back
quests.mira.title: Chapter 2 · The Withered Herb Field
